svg.text: One window, one tile: the tile area D × Δf is always 1
Short window: D = 5 ms, Δf = 200 Hz
Tile width 5 ms < pitch period 8.33 ms:
Tile height 200 Hz > harmonic spacing 120 Hz:
Long window: D = 30 ms, Δf = 33.3 Hz
Tile height 33.3 Hz < harmonic spacing 120 Hz:
Blue dashes: pulses every 8.33 ms (F0 = 120 Hz). Ink lines: harmonics every 120 Hz. Gold: tiles.
